text.short: Sweet, Gem County, on Highway 52. Friday to Sunday only, and Basque because of one family.
text.today: Friday eleven to ten, Saturday eight to ten, Sunday eight to nine. Aaron Lowe runs it.
text.history: The Basque cooking here carries on from Michelle Anchustegui, through her family and the dishes she made.
text.note: Chorizo is on now; the house has said paella and more are coming.

seating.note: A country dining room; you take a table.

kin.how: the state this room sits in
a three-day week is its own answer to when, if not how

founded.by: Aaron Lowe now; the Basque cooking descends from Michelle Anchustegui
